uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

1981-2415-6578-7272.easyPrerequisites: You either have Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER on the battlefield or have the emblem granted by Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel.
1981-2415-6578-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
1981-2415-6578-7272.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Sephiroth and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Sephiroth trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for {0} that dies on enter

567-1957-2530--203.easyPrerequisites: You either have at least 2 life or {B} available.
567-1957-2530--203.description:
Cast the creature card from your hand for {0}. The creature enters, then immediately dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
When the creature enters, Carnival of Souls and Soul's Attendant trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls ability, adding {B} and losing 1 life.
Resolve the Soul's Attendant ability, gaining at least 1 life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3951-4247-4452-5703.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
3951-4247-4452-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

728-4802--5.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat

1308-6441-6753-6763-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

851-1308-3129-5478-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
851-1308-3129-5478-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

2034-2366-5003-7889.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dryad Arbor, adding {C}{C}.
When Dryad Arbor dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Dryad Arbor enters the battlefield, Dancing from Dark to Dawn triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

5686-7804--5.notablePrerequisites: The top card of your library is a nonland card.
5686-7804--5.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Captain Kathryn Janeway triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat

1895-3188-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Pearl Medallion.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Social Climber trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Social Climber trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1895-3188-4399-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1251-3259-7794.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1251-3259-7794.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Koma, triggering Breath of Fury and Koma.
Resolve the Koma trigger, creating four creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

2060-2576-4222-6996.easyPrerequisites:
Temple Elder does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Temple Elder.
It is before attackers have been declared.
2060-2576-4222-6996.description:
Activate Temple Elder by tapping it, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's ability by paying {U}, untapping Temple Elder.
Repeat.

uses.n: Oko, Lorwyn Liege // Oko, Shadowmoor Scion

1486-1753-5475-7176.description:
Activate Oko, Lorwyn Liege's first ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, causing Forensic Researcher to gain all creature types.
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Samut trigger, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat from step 2.
1486-1753-5475-7176.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

1479-2374-2841-6159.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bloodstained Mire.
Your life total is at least 2.
1479-2374-2841-6159.description:
Fetch a land using Bloodstained Mire.
When the fetched land enters, Maja and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Maja trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Maja from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Maja triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

539-6620-7034.description:
Cast Bumi by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable
When Bumi enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing Bumi
When Bumi dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Bumi enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Sylvan Safekeeper abilities.

942-4067-6281-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that share a creature type.
942-4067-6281-7013.description:
Activate White Lotus Tile by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Samwise the Stouthearted.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Samwise the Stouthearted that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Samwise the Stouthearted token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Samwise the Stouthearted from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping White Lotus Tile.
Repeat.

1350-4010-4885-6723.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton by paying at least {3}{G}{W}
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and three Food tokens.
Activate Farmer Cotton, three Halflings and three Foods by tapping them, adding {4}{G}{G}{W}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Farmer Cotton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1350-4010-4885-6723.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} additional to start to get infinite untapped tokens. This mana will be recuperated throughout the combo.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-4798-6462.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
392-4798-6462.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Ovalchase Daredevil triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers. Holding priority, activate Harnfel by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil.
Resolve the Kheru Goldkeeper trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 2.

813-957-3563.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, taking two extra turns.
Cast Flicker of Fate by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Stretch and Flicker of Fate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each other turn.
813-957-3563.notes: If desired, you can do steps 2 and 3 during the first extra turn instead to spread out the mana costs.

3595-6185-6280.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in hand.
3595-6185-6280.description:
Activate Shambling Shell's cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it, causing you to mill a number of cards and return Shambling Shell from your graveyard to your hand due to its dredge ability.
Repeat.

710-2511-2961.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, False Demise triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

372-2493-2955.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Justiciar's Portal exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Archaeomancer exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Justiciar's Portal.
372-2493-2955.description:
Cast Justiciar's Portal by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Archaeomancer and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Archaeomancer trigger.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Justiciar's Portal from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Justiciar's Portal.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Archaeomancer and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

235-1218-4150.description:
Cast Tainted Strike by paying {B}, giving Imodane +1/+0 and infect until end of turn.
Cast Shivan Meteor by paying {3}{R}{R}, dealing 13 damage to any creature.
Imodane triggers, giving each opponent thirteen poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten or more poison counters.

678-2060-2123-2438-4017.notablePrerequisites:
Sunbond attached to Crystalline Crawler.
You have at least two opponents.
678-2060-2123-2438-4017.description:
Cast Kokusho by paying {4}{B}{B}.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Kokusho.
When Kokusho dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Kokusho from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Kokusho trigger, causing each opponent to lose 5 life and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Crystalline Crawler triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the life you gained.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {4}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

139-684-3158-5109.notablePrerequisites:
Gollum does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block Gollum.
139-684-3158-5109.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Gollum.
Activate The Moment's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, phasing out Gollum until The Moment leaves the battlefield.
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Volcano Hellion enters the battlefield, it triggers, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to you and Volcano Hellion.
Instead of you losing the game as a state-based action, Lich's Mirror causes you to shuffle your hand, graveyard and all permanents you own into your library, causing Gollum to phase in as The Moment leaves the battlefield, and setting your life total to 20.
At the beginning of your end step, Gollum triggers, causing an opponent to lose life equal to the life you gained this turn.

1718-2882-3079-4999.notablePrerequisites:
Infinite Reflection attached to Catalyst Elemental.
You have discarded at least two cards this turn.
1718-2882-3079-4999.description:
Cast Hollow One either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying at most {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield as a copy of Catalyst Elemental due to Infinite Reflection.
Activate Hollow One by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
If you cast Hollow One from your graveyard, Hollow One is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Infinite Reflection removing Hollow One's cycling ability.
Repeat.

500-851-3035-4688-4751.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill Nadier.
500-851-3035-4688-4751.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Verdurous Gearhulk and creating four token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Verdurous Gearhulk tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, putting at least seven +1/+1 counters on Nadier, and the remaining nine +1/+1 counters on any creature(s) you control.
Kill Nadier, triggering its ability, creating at least twenty 1/1 Elf Warrior creature tokens.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Epic Struggle triggers, causing you to win the game.

1242-2092-2335-2757.notablePrerequisites:
Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 4 or greater.
You control at least one basic Mountain and at least one basic Forest.
1242-2092-2335-2757.description:
Activate a basic Mountain and Forest by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Earthcraft twice by tapping Cinderhaze Wretch and Barrenton Medic, untapping the Mountain and Forest.
Activate Agatha of the Vile Cauldron by paying at most {R}{G}, giving all other creatures you control +1/+1, trample and haste until end of turn.
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch and Barrenton Medic's second abilities by putting a -1/-1 counter on them, untapping them.
Repeat.

2136-2816-2972.notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
Umbral Mantle attached to Orthion.
2136-2816-2972.description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Ganax with haste.
Put all Ganax tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Each Ganax triggers five times.
Resolve all Ganax triggers, creating 30 Treasure tokens.
Activate twelve Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {9}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Orthion by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead target any other creature using Orthion's ability.

490-2440-2972-3809.notablePrerequisites: You control a modified creature that can attack this turn.
490-2440-2972-3809.description:
Declare any modified creature you control as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate Goro-Goro's second ability by paying {3}{R}{R}, creating a 5/5 Dragon Spirit creature token with flying.
When the Dragon Spirit enters the battlefield, it triggers Mana Echoes and Ganax.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding at least {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
 Once you have infinite tokens, you may use Goro-Goro's first ability to give them haste.

1636-2034-4242-4331.notablePrerequisites: Drafna does not have summoning sickness.
1636-2034-4242-4331.description:
Cast Su-Chi by paying {4}.
Holding priority, activate Drafna's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, copying the Su-Chi spell.
Resolve the copy of the Su-Chi spell, creating a token copy of Su-Chi.
The token Su-Chi enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Su-Chi token, adding {C}{C}.
The token Su-Chi dies, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Su-Chi tokens.

1178-1494-3313.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Shrines.
1178-1494-3313.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Honden of Cleansing Fire triggers, causing you to gain at least six life.
Proceed to your end step.
At the beginning of your end step, Lathiel triggers, putting at least six +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, taking at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

224-2248-3147.description:
Activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Skyshroud Ranger.
Repeat.

413-2018-3826.easyPrerequisites: Medicine Runner does not have a flying counter on it.
413-2018-3826.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Medicine Runner.
When Medicine Runner dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Medicine Runner from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
When Medicine Runner enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Medicine Runner trigger, removing the flying counter from Medicine Runner.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.
